title: Explicit Ricci-flat Metrics on Kummer K3 Surfaces
summary: We give a convergent explicit representation of the Ricci-flat Kähler metrics supplied by the Calabi--Yau theorem in a one-parameter family of classes on a fixed Kummer K3 surface. An explicit radial background has normalized Monge--Ampère residual \(O(a^4)\). Its scalar Green operator \(G_a\) is represented by periodic Ewald kernels, separated radial kernels, finite-dimensional Schur complements, and convergent Neumann series.
